pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

2. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

4. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

6. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

10. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Handball.

11. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — The speed of the music

6. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. D — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing and Painting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
